title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Wear Allowance for a Punctual Payment Record
content:
**Training note — the payment-record addition to wear forgiveness on a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Rule.** The wear forgiveness punctual-payment addition is $150 (the clean-record addition) when no late charge was ever assessed on the lease, $75 (the one-late-charge addition) when exactly one late charge was assessed on the lease, and nothing when two or more were, a late charge counting even if it was later waived. The addition is added to the wear forgiveness cap of the turn-in before the wear forgiveness is measured against that enlarged limit.

**Questions the rule answers**

*Which late charges count?* Every late charge ever assessed on the lease, over its whole life. A late charge that was later waived — by courtesy or for a servicing error — still counts.

*Does a returned-payment fee count as a late charge here?* No. The count is of late charges only.

| Late charges ever assessed on the lease | Of which later waived | Addition to the wear forgiveness cap |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | — | $150 |
| 1 | 0 | $75 |
| 1 | 1 | $75 |
| 2 | 1 | nothing |
| 4 | 0 | nothing |

**Worked illustration (hypothetical)**: a lease with one late charge, later waived, turns in with an excess wear charge of $520 and a wear forgiveness cap of $250. The cap becomes $250 plus $75, that is $325, and the forgiveness is measured against $325.
